checks.name: Weighted cache bounds, replacement accounting and deterministic LRU eviction
Real importer produces identical verified bytes and cache identity
Oversized sources reject before reading bytes
Failed importer retry inputs and memory caches stay within declared budgets
Late image metadata failure retains all authored source fields and stable identity
Successful reimport keeps identity/path while replacing validated content
Reimport completion cannot overwrite an edit made during metadata decoding
Path repair preserves prefixes, JSON keys, comments, prose and binary data
Complete UUID repair preserves Unicode base64 and never rewrites longer tokens
Folder move preserves UUIDs and fully rolls back paths/sources/provenance on failure
Dependency roots ignore embedded asset inventory and entity parent UUIDs
Closure reports missing, editor-only, excluded and unknown-group dependencies
Explicit include/exclude rules cannot silently sever required closure
Resource inheritance and inherited variant selection use the supplied asset snapshot
Resource kind mismatch, cycles and local variant overflow are rejected
Atlas groups occupy different pages and reordered inputs produce identical placements
Actual canvas atlas builder separates groups and retains failures instead of partial output
Authoritative package contains exactly closure metadata/files and retains referenced optional resources
Repair updates complete metadata references and bare resource parents without changing document identity
Comment references do not create build dependencies; literal paths and raw host use forms do
Typed visual graph module dependencies follow current graph semantics
Aseprite golden identities survive source reorder and source fingerprint is actual SHA-256
Tiled aggregate cell limits reject small inputs that would allocate excessive generated layers
Interchange texture binding is stable across image rename and diagnoses ambiguous basenames
Real importer cancellation drains active and queued reads without retry leakage
Retrying a failed reimport updates the existing UUID rather than duplicating the asset
Persistent-cache corruption is replaced with verified bytes; cache quota failure is recoverable
Failed external reimport remains visible for recovery
Actual common exporter narrows scene roots and rejects broken closure before browser/native output
Every bundled starter has a valid dependency closure with and without unused stripping
Malformed graph dependencies become visible diagnostics and block only relevant closure
Atlas maximum size is applied per group, padding failures are explicit and empty reports have zero pages
Duplicate package IDs/paths reject before reading any source bytes
Build patterns and folders never become roots; exact missing paths preserve case
Missing interchange textures block closure, stable texture UUIDs are included
Font constructor/decode/registration failures retain source and tracked faces are released
Artifact settings, atlas placement and package ordering are independent of locale collation
Package bytes and entry identity use the pre-await snapshot
Source watches suppress stale polls/debounces and retain failed changes
Atlas decoding limits concurrent work and rejects excessive decoded pixels before drawing
Rhai path repair preserves comments/raw host escapes and edits complete raw/template literals
Aseprite tags retain source frame indices when deterministic slice sorting changes order
Inherited active variants survive save/reload and unresolved selections cannot mutate saved source
